# O2om (قُوم) — Stand-Up Break Timer & Ergonomic Posture Coach for Windows

> O2om (derived from Arabic "قُوم", meaning "Stand up!") is an open-source, high-craft desktop health and posture utility for Windows built with AutoHotkey v2. It features multi-mode ergonomics (Stand-Up, Eye Guard 20-20-20, Pomodoro), step-by-step guided stretch routines, daily health analytics, a floating mini-pill widget, physical idle absence detection, and native Arabic (RTL) & English localization.

## Key Technical Specifications
- Project Name: O2om (قُوم)
- Version: v3.0.0
- Target Platform: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Language & Runtime: AutoHotkey v2.0+ (Strict v2 syntax)
- Architecture: Layered Clean Architecture (`src/Core/`, `src/Services/`, `src/Ui/`, `src/Locale/`)
- Localization: Native Arabic (Right-to-Left layout via WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL +E0x400000) & English (LTR)
- Visual Theme: Modern Obsidian Dark Palette with Windows DWM Immersive Dark Titlebar
- Memory Footprint: < 15MB RAM
- License: Open Source

## Core Features
1. Multi-Mode Ergonomic Engine: Stand-Up & Posture mode (40m/5m), 20-20-20 Eye Strain Guard (20m/20s), Deep Work Pomodoro (25m/5m), and Custom intervals.
2. Interactive Guided Break Overlay: Step-by-step stretch coach with per-exercise countdown timers, audio cues, and clean 16:9 posture illustrations.
3. Daily Health Analytics & Streaks: Tracks completed stands against daily goals, total focus time, and multi-day streaks in `o2om_stats.ini`.
4. Floating Mini-Pill Widget: Draggable, always-on-top 160x46px micro-widget for distraction-free countdown monitoring.
5. Physical Idle Absence Detection: Auto-pauses work countdown via `A_TimeIdlePhysical` when user steps away, without interrupting break countdowns.
6. Zero-Flicker DWM Dark GUI: Utilizes `WS_CLIPCHILDREN` (+0x02000000) and `DwmSetWindowAttribute` for native Windows 10/11 dark title bars.
